title: bedrock grass and dirt
description: This makes the grass and dirt textures both look like bedrock. it is pretty useless.
body: the dirt and grass is no longer disgusting dirt, instead it is bedrock. It is not very useful but maybe someone will like this pack. looks good on superflats. it is kinda confusing sometimes but it is what it says. The pack will probably say it is not up to date for your version, but most likely it will work with your version, it just changes grass and dirt.
